title: The Paired Hawk Ward Course
summary: A school course in twin plates that bind an attacker and close on the fall of two hawks as one shield.

title: Manual of the Azure Court Ward
summary: A school manual of measured wards that weigh each blow and close on the plate that gives judgement.

title: The Twin Plate Discipline
summary: A discipline of two plates held in rhythm that ends in a stroke which sunders the guard the plates have worn down.

title: The Wide Azure Aegis
summary: A manual of the azure sky that spreads the aegis across the qi field and ends in a rising wing of ward.

title: The Basin Aegis of the Core
summary: A school manual that gathers the ward in the Core as in a basin and releases it as one absolute aegis.

title: The Oath Ward Course of the Plateau
summary: A school course of the plateau that ties each ward to a spoken vow and closes on the plate which the oathkeeper alone may lift.

title: Manual of the Wind-Sworn Shield
summary: A school manual of the wind-sworn in which the shield turns blows with the gale and returns them with the oath.

title: The Bearing Discipline
summary: A discipline of the held bearing that teaches the warden to take a line of ground and keep it against any weight.

title: The Open Wind Aegis
summary: A school manual of an aegis with no rim and no wall that opens like the wind over the sworn and closes on the last blow.

title: The Unwalled Core Ward
summary: A school manual in which the ward leaves the Core and spreads over the sworn with no wall and no limit but the oath.
